milestone: T12 — Scientific-Compute Planner Fidelity and Promotion Closure
record: Defects discovered DURING the final evaluation runs. The hardened implementation is frozen at commit 132ec6b; per the same discipline applied to engine quirks, these are MEASURED as found, not repaired mid-milestone. Per-item exceptions are recorded by the runner (instrument hotfix, this commit); the graded item outcome is conservatively correct=False.

defects.site: fidelity.py:197 _merge_sub_results -> max() over empty sub-classification list
defects.trigger: check_fidelity on a faithful request whose structured parameter is an EMPTY container. First reproduced on frozen fidelity-suite item mfid-v1-0020 (kind REJECT, MALFORMED_ODE, faithful inputs contain initial_state: [] by design: ODE with no initial condition).
defects.exception: ValueError: max() iterable argument is empty
defects.designed_behavior: classify_transformation should classify an empty container (e.g. as a legal no-element source or a normalization) and continue; the engine itself handles initial_state=[] (returns the declared non-PASS status, verified at suite build time).
defects.measured_consequence: The fidelity layer crashes on the item instead of classifying it; the request is never executed (safety holds: no engine run, no asserted number) but the designed clean gate behavior does not occur. The rerun records mfid-v1-0020 as a pipeline_exception row with correct=False.
defects.disposition: NOT REPAIRED (frozen system under test). Measured via per-item exception capture in the evaluation runner (instrument, scripts/t12_scicomp_eval.py hotfix).

defects.trigger: Faithful numeric_oracle items where the planner re-expresses equation text as the structured parameter the operation schema requires (e.g. '4x + 1y = 9; 2x + 3y = 13' -> matrix [[4,1],[2,3]], b [9,13]).
defects.measured: 11 PARAMETER_FIDELITY_FAIL rows on numeric_oracle items in run t12-final-scicomp-B (msc-v1-0009,0010,0011,0012,0013,0018,0075,0078,0080,0094,0102), all with TYPE_CHANGED as the first failure; 7 of them are right->wrong flips vs T11 arm B (the remaining 4 were already wrong or newly right).
defects.consequence: The gate rejects faithful numeric requests, so the model answers directly and loses oracle points; this is the dominant mechanism in the 24-row numeric regression (T11-B 117/138 = 0.8478 -> T12-B 97/138 = 0.7029; flips: 11 guard, 7 fidelity gate, 5 planner-schema failures, 1 planner decline).
defects.disposition: MEASURED, not repaired (frozen system under test).

defects.layer: T12 evaluation runner (scripts/t12_scicomp_eval.py) — instrument, NOT the system under test
defects.site: _registry_lines_static() returned a str; t11.build_b1_system(manifest_lines) does '\n'.join(manifest_lines), which over a str joins its CHARACTERS
defects.trigger: Any arm-A leg using the T11 B1-planner flow (scicomp-A attempts at 11:09 and 15:0x on 2026-09-08; fidelity-A attempts 1/3/4). The 4,258-char registry became a 9,146-char one-character-per-line prompt = 7,300 tokens (vs the correct 4,889 chars / ~1,300 tokens).
defects.mechanism_proof: Prefill SDPA scores at L=7300: 32 heads x 7300^2 x 4 bytes (fp32) = 6.351 GiB — exactly the 'Tried to allocate 6.35 GiB' in every OOM (scicomp variant 6.38 GiB = L~7316, differing only by question length). Confirmed by SDPA shape capture q=(1,32,7300,128) in a debug run, and by CHAT system=9146ch TOKENS=7300.
defects.consequence: Deterministic CUDA OOM at the first planner prefill on the 6,141 MiB card; 0 rows in every affected attempt. All affected attempts were initially classified INFRASTRUCTURE_INTERRUPTION; with the mechanism proven, they are reattributed to this runner defect (instrument). The system under test (engine, fidelity layer, hardened planner/adopter) is exonerated of all five OOM events.
defects.disposition: REPAIRED in the instrument (helper now returns list[str], matching T11's own runner usage); arms using PLANNER_SYSTEM_T12.format(registry=str) were always correct and unaffected. The 2026-09-08 ~15:3x OS kill of fidelity-A attempt 2 (host RAM pressure) remains a genuine INFRASTRUCTURE_INTERRUPTION.

defects.layer: T12 final audit instrument (scripts/t12_final_audit.py) — NOT the system under test
defects.site: engine_freeze_intact gate (plus the T12.33 adapter-sha extraction)
defects.trigger: First audit run produced spurious verdicts: (1) t12_entry_gate.json stores checks as a LIST of {check,status,detail} but the audit called .get on it (AttributeError); (2) the freeze gate resolved bare filenames at the repo ROOT instead of src/sciencemath/scicomp/ (17 files falsely MISSING); (3) freeze-record values are plain sha256 strings but the audit called .get('sha256') on them; (4) the gate ignored the freeze record's own policy clause authorizing changes to planner schema/validation, routing guard, and result-adoption interface.
defects.measured_effect_on_first_run: engine_freeze_intact FAIL -> decision REJECT_SCICOMP, despite 16/17 engine files being byte-identical and the single change (router.py, the routing guard) being explicitly authorized by the freeze record's policy and made in the authorized hardening commit 8262a74 (clean working tree, unchanged since).
defects.disposition: REPAIRED in the instrument (audit script is not frozen code): base path corrected, sha-string values handled, checks-list shape handled, and the AUTHORIZED_LAYERS policy encoded with explicit justification strings emitted in the gate detail. Solver files remain byte-identity-gated.
